capabilities: Write metamorpheme syntax to cycle through alternative words in one place
Set per-morpheme hold and fade timings with @H and @%F markers
Choose transition style and alignment (zoom, diffuse, slide, crossfade)
Override default settings per set with the $ $ marker
Keep unique markdown per morpheme or wrap the set in one block
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's prose explanation is poetic while the syntax section is concrete.
problem: Obsidian notes can hold only one word or title in a spot, so layered meanings, undecided names, multilingual terms and multiple senses cannot be shown together.
summary: Inline syntax that renders several words, titles or translations cycling through the same place, one morpheme at a time.
